changelog.summary: Move a bounded customer problem through accepted priority into reviewable product requirements without silently opening delivery work.

title: Opportunity to Reviewed Requirements
description: Move a bounded customer problem through accepted priority into reviewable product requirements without silently opening delivery work.
setup_prompt: Use Opportunity to Reviewed Requirements as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Crews, source permissions, exact subject, owner and action policy. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, typed handoffs, a real manual first case and separate approval for consequential actions. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection enables no write or recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: One product, customer segment, opportunity and strategy horizon; preserve participant privacy and the current roadmap revision.
Use authorized research, current opportunity and roadmap records, an approved strategy goal, and current design or behavior evidence.
Discovery is evidence, Product priority needs explicit owner acceptance, and requirements stay a draft until Product, Design and Engineering review.
Accountable source, decision and action owners
Authorized connections or equivalent current exports
Manual-only or reviewed event and schedule policy
